name: ProGroCo Pre-Roll | Orange Push Pop
description:
Lineage: Orange Cookies x Triangle Kush

Type: Indica-dominant hybrid

Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, and Myrcene

Aroma: Sweet orange, citrus, and creamy vanilla notes

Effects: Euphoric, relaxed, happy, and uplifted

A creamy citrus classic—Triangle Kush × Orange Cookies delivers sweet orange, zesty citrus, and smooth vanilla with a hint of earth. The vibe starts bright and euphoric with clear-headed uplift, then eases into a cozy, tingly body calm without knocking you out. Like your favorite freezer pop… but better.
